input_payload: Payment failure spike: 23% of UPI transactions failing with error code 'BENEFICIARY_BANK_TIMEOUT' between 14:00–14:45 IST. Investigate root cause.
evidence_pool: NPCI switch latency p99 spiked to 8.2s at 14:03 IST (normal < 2s).
Internal payment router logs show 100% of failures routing via beneficiary bank 'SBI UPI'.
SBI NPCI node status page: 'Partial Degradation' reported at 14:00 IST.
Retry queue depth increased 400% during the window.
No changes deployed to internal routing service in past 72 hours.
ground_truth: Root cause: SBI UPI node degradation on NPCI caused beneficiary-side timeouts; no internal failure.

input_payload: Settlement batch for 2026-08-14 failed to process for 3,400 merchants. Settlements are 18 hours overdue. Investigate.
evidence_pool: Settlement batch job timed out at 02:14 IST; job log shows 'DB connection pool exhausted'.
Read replica lag reached 47 seconds at 02:10 IST (threshold: 5s).
Database maintenance window ran 23:00–02:00 IST; vacuum operation not completed.
Alert: disk I/O on primary DB host at 98% utilization from 01:45–02:30 IST.
No backup read replica promoted during the incident window.
ground_truth: Root cause: DB vacuum during maintenance caused I/O saturation and read replica lag, exhausting connection pool for settlement batch job.

input_payload: Webhook delivery failure rate 67% for all merchants from 09:00–11:30 IST. Merchants report missing payment notifications. Investigate.
evidence_pool: Webhook dispatcher service restarted 3 times between 09:00 and 10:00 IST.
OOM killer log: dispatcher process killed at 08:57 IST; heap at 95% of limit.
Payload size spike: average webhook payload grew from 1.2 KB to 14 KB after v2.3.1 deploy at 08:45 IST.
v2.3.1 release notes: 'Added full transaction metadata to webhook payload'.
No autoscaling trigger fired; memory limit unchanged since v1.8.
ground_truth: Root cause: v2.3.1 webhook payload bloat caused OOM kills on dispatcher; memory limits not updated for new payload size.

input_payload: Card payment authorization rate dropped from 94% to 71% at 16:00 IST. Card network error codes show 'ISSUER_NOT_AVAILABLE'. Investigate.
evidence_pool: Visa network advisory: 'Issuer connectivity issues for HDFC Bank cards' issued at 15:58 IST.
HDFC Bank card auth success rate: 38% (normal 96%) from 16:00 IST.
Non-HDFC card auth rate: 95% (unchanged).
Internal 3DS server response time normal throughout.
Customer complaints concentrated on HDFC debit/credit card users.
ground_truth: Root cause: HDFC Bank issuer-side outage on Visa network; no internal payment stack failure.

input_payload: Payout processing latency increased 5x for IMPS transfers from 13:00 IST. Average latency 45s vs normal 9s. Investigate.
evidence_pool: NPCI IMPS processing queue backlog: 1.2 million transactions at 13:05 IST.
RBI circular released at 12:45 IST mandating additional AML screening for IMPS payouts above INR 5 lakh.
Internal AML screening service processing 3x normal volume; CPU at 89%.
New AML rule deployed at 12:50 IST triggered by RBI circular implementation.
Payout amounts above INR 5 lakh represent 34% of volume, up from 12% after month-end bulk payouts.
ground_truth: Root cause: new RBI-mandated AML screening rule combined with month-end payout volume spike overloaded AML screening service, cascading into NPCI queue backlog.
